record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare MACH_PUNCH: Ledyba (1 star), Ledian (2 stars), Tyrogue (2 stars, passive TYROGUE) and Kubfu (2 stars, passive KUBFU). The strategy is shared; differences are the star index, maxPP and passives (passives not traced).
record.summary: The caster deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target (requested 25/50/100/200 by stars) and then resets its own action cooldown to round(100 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) ms, so it can act again quickly. No status or movement is involved.

targeting.note: Single target; the caster is only affected through the cooldown reset.

effects.scaling: x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost default true); DOUBLE_DAMAGE doubles and is consumed; STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT x1.2; x critPower scaled by crit negation only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied: blocked entirely (takenDamage 0) if the target is protected, skydiving or magic bouncing; otherwise PokemonState.handleDamage divides SPECIAL damage by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF and applies further modifiers and shields (requested vs applied vs takenDamage differ; takenDamage as reported by handleDamage includes shield damage per the shared reference, not re-traced here)

effects.scaling: depends on the caster's current speed at cast time; no AP or crit scaling
effects.resolution: sets pokemon.cooldown (overwriting any existing value); how the cooldown gates the next attack is in the state machine and was not traced

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry is also the fallback. Listed units are 1 or 2 stars. The cooldown base is not star dependent.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond the cast target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode; each cast repeats the hit and the cooldown reset.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): 25 (Ledyba) / 50 (Ledian, Tyrogue, Kubfu). Applied: requested x AP x modifiers (crit if any), then divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF in handleDamage, with later reductions; shields absorb in handleDamage and takenDamage reports what handleDamage returns. Blocked casts deal 0.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: handleDamage's later reductions and shield handling beyond the SPE_DEF line were not traced; see knowledge core-mechanics §A
How resetCooldown's value is consumed by the attack state machine was not traced
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, canCast) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
unresolved: Passives TYROGUE and KUBFU were not traced; whether they modify the cast is unknown
Whether the cooldown reset also applies when the target dies or the damage is blocked: the call is unconditional in the strategy, later state effects not traced
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
